# mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse — Complete Technical Knowledge Base & API Specification

> Enterprise-Grade Telegram Mirror, Leech & Linux FUSE Zero-Double-Storage Engine with Multi-Session TDLib Concurrency Pooling and Fault-Tolerant Cloud Replication.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Architecture

### 1.1 Problem Statement: The Double-Storage Bottleneck
In legacy mirror and leech bot engines, processing multi-gigabyte compressed archives (`.zip`, `.tar`, `.7z`, `.rar`, `.iso`) requires downloading the archive, physically extracting its full contents to disk via utilities like `7z x`, and creating pre-split chunks before commencing upload. 

```
[Legacy Double-Storage Flow: Total Disk Peak ~88.2 GB]
Download (32.8 GB .zip) ──▶ Full Disk Extract (+35.2 GB) ──▶ Upfront Splits (+20.2 GB)
   Result: Instant ENOSPC failure on 84 GB SSD partitions.
```

### 1.2 The FUSE Zero-Double-Storage Solution
`mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse` replaces physical extraction with dynamic Linux Virtual File System (VFS) mounting using `archivemount -o readonly,nosave`. The virtual file extents are streamed and decompressed on-the-fly directly into the streaming split and upload pipelines.

```
[FUSE Zero-Double-Storage Flow: Peak Disk Capped at ~35.2 GB]
Download (32.8 GB .zip) ──▶ FUSE VFS Mount (.mnt_*) ──▶ Stream Single File Chunk (~2.4 GB) ──▶ Direct Upload & Purge
   Result: >50% peak storage reduction, zero double-storage penalty.
```

### 1.3 Key Modules & Responsibilities
- `bot/helper/listeners/task_listener.py`: Central lifecycle manager orchestrating downloads, extractions, splits, upload dispatching, status updates, and atomic teardown.
- `bot/modules/zip_selector.py`: Interactive Telegram inline ZIP GUI picker featuring 8 items/page pagination, `<64B` callback keys, 60s auto-done timeout, and multi-tier authorization.
- `bot/helper/ext_utils/files_utils.py`: Contains `SevenZ.extract()` for `archivemount` lifecycle management and `clean_download()` with active `/proc/mounts` unmounting (`fusermount -uz`).
- `bot/helper/common.py`: Core task state holder implementing `proceed_split_streaming()`, `_picker_small_only` detection, and `is_leech` isolation guards.
- `bot/core/tdlib_manager.py`: Manages multi-session TDLib userbot clusters (`tdlib_user_*`) with round-robin dispatching under concurrency locks and `_patch_tdjson_binding()` runtime C-FFI fixes.
- `bot/helper/mirror_leech_utils/tdlib_uploader.py`: High-throughput TDLib uploader with parallel chunk tracking and thread-safe reply chaining.
- `bot/helper/ext_utils/media_utils.py`: Smart WZML media metadata engine extracting resolution, duration, audio languages (`langcodes`), and subtitle streams via `ffprobe`.

## 3. Complete JSON Schema Definitions

### 3.1 Task Listener Lifecycle Events Schema
The Task Listener manages task transitions from download initiation to final cleanup.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "TaskListenerEvent",
  "description": "Schema for internal lifecycle events dispatched by TaskListener in bot/helper/listeners/task_listener.py",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "mid",
    "event_type",
    "timestamp",
    "task_name",
    "is_leech",
    "stage"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mid": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Telegram Message ID uniquely identifying the task instance"
    },
    "event_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "DOWNLOAD_START",
        "DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE",
        "DOWNLOAD_ERROR",
        "EXTRACT_START",
        "ZIP_PICKER_TRIGGERED",
        "ZIP_PICKER_COMPLETED",
        "SPLIT_STREAM_START",
        "UPLOAD_START",
        "UPLOAD_PROGRESS",
        "UPLOAD_COMPLETE",
        "UPLOAD_ERROR",
        "GDRIVE_BACKUP_START",
        "GDRIVE_BACKUP_COMPLETE",
        "TASK_FINALIZED"
      ]
    },
    "timestamp": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Unix epoch timestamp in seconds"
    },
    "task_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Display name of the task, file, or archive"
    },
    "is_leech": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True if task is a Telegram Leech, False if Cloud Mirror"
    },
    "stage": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "downloading",
        "extracting",
        "selecting",
        "splitting",
        "telegram_upload",
        "gdrive_secondary",
        "rclone_upload",
        "completed",
        "failed"
      ]
    },
    "download_meta": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "engine": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["aria2", "qbittorrent", "sabnzbd", "jdownloader", "yt_dlp", "direct"]
        },
        "total_size": {
          "type": "integer",
          "description": "Total payload size in bytes"
        },
        "download_path": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Absolute filesystem path to downloaded artifacts"
        },
        "fuse_mounted": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Whether archive was mounted via archivemount"
        },
        "fuse_mount_points": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    },
    "upload_meta": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "backend": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["tdlib", "pyrogram", "gdrive", "rclone"]
        },
        "uploaded_files_count": { "type": "integer" },
        "corrupted_files_count": { "type": "integer" },
        "links": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" }
        },
        "gdrive_result": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "status": { "type": "string", "enum": ["uploaded", "skipped", "failed"] },
            "link": { "type": "string" },
            "dir_id": { "type": "string" },
            "error": { "type": "string" }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "error_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Detailed error string if event represents a failure"
    }
  }
}
```

### 3.2 ZIP Picker Telegram Callback Payload Schema
The interactive ZIP picker GUI encodes user selections into callback query data constrained by Telegram's 64-byte payload limit.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "ZipPickerCallbackPayload",
  "description": "Schema for Telegram inline keyboard callback data formatted as 'zipsel <mid> <action> [args]' (<64 bytes)",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["prefix", "mid", "action"],
  "properties": {
    "raw_string": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 64,
      "pattern": "^zipsel \\d+ (t \\d+ \\d+|p \\d+|all( \\d+)?|none( \\d+)?|done( \\d+)?|cancel( \\d+)?)$",
      "description": "Raw space-separated callback string sent in Telegram CallbackQuery"
    },
    "prefix": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "zipsel"
    },
    "mid": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Task Message ID matching listener.mid"
    },
    "action": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["t", "p", "all", "none", "done", "cancel"],
      "description": "'t'=toggle item, 'p'=change page, 'all'=select all, 'none'=deselect all, 'done'=confirm selection, 'cancel'=abort task"
    },
    "item_index": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "0-based index of the target file in the sorted archive file list (present only when action='t')"
    },
    "page_index": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "0-based current page index in the 8 items/page paginated view"
    },
    "authorization": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["caller_user_id", "is_authorized"],
      "properties": {
        "caller_user_id": { "type": "integer" },
        "is_authorized": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "True if caller is OWNER_ID, SUDO_USER, or task initiator (listener.user_id)"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 3.3 TDLib Worker Stats & Runtime Metrics Schema
Captures operational metrics from the TDLib multi-session concurrency pool and background worker threads.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "TdlibWorkerStats",
  "description": "Schema representing runtime health, session pool status, and transmission performance metrics",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "timestamp",
    "is_available",
    "active_workers_count",
    "pool_size",
    "global_stats",
    "sessions"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "timestamp": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Snapshot timestamp in epoch seconds"
    },
    "is_available": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True if TdlibManager initialized successfully without fatal library or auth errors"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Initialization or runtime error string if unavailable"
    },
    "is_premium_user": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True if primary or pooled userbot has Telegram Premium active (allowing up to 4GB files)"
    },
    "pool_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Total number of active authenticated TDLib client instances in the pool"
    },
    "active_workers_count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Number of upload threads currently executing across all tasks"
    },
    "concurrency_limits": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "tg_file_upload_concurrency",
        "tg_split_upload_concurrency",
        "tg_upload_workers"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "tg_file_upload_concurrency": { "type": "integer", "default": 8 },
        "tg_split_upload_concurrency": { "type": "integer", "default": 4 },
        "tg_upload_workers": { "type": "integer", "default": 16 }
      }
    },
    "global_stats": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["total_bytes_sent", "instantaneous_speed_bytes_sec", "active_tasks_count"],
      "properties": {
        "total_bytes_sent": { "type": "integer" },
        "instantaneous_speed_bytes_sec": { "type": "number" },
        "active_tasks_count": { "type": "integer" }
      }
    },
    "sessions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": ["index", "db_path", "is_authorized", "is_healthy"],
        "properties": {
          "index": { "type": "integer" },
          "db_path": { "type": "string" },
          "user_id": { "type": "integer" },
          "first_name": { "type": "string" },
          "username": { "type": "string" },
          "is_authorized": { "type": "boolean" },
          "is_healthy": { "type": "boolean" },
          "current_load": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "Number of concurrent uploads currently bound to this session instance"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## 5. Production VPS Tuning & Performance Optimization

### 5.1 Linux Kernel & Virtual Memory Tuning (`/etc/sysctl.conf`)
High-concurrency transfers across FUSE, TDLib, aria2c, and qBittorrent generate substantial network sockets and dirty memory pages. Add the following parameters to `/etc/sysctl.conf`:

```ini
# Virtual Memory & Page Cache Tuning
vm.dirty_background_ratio = 5
vm.dirty_ratio = 10
vm.vfs_cache_pressure = 50
vm.swappiness = 10

# File Descriptors & Inotify Watches
fs.file-max = 2097152
fs.inotify.max_user_watches = 524288
fs.inotify.max_user_instances = 8192

# TCP / Network Stack Optimization (BBR + Expanded Buffers)
net.core.default_qdisc = fq
net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = bbr
net.core.somaxconn = 65535
net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 65535
net.core.rmem_max = 67108864
net.core.wmem_max = 67108864
net.core.rmem_default = 33554432
net.core.wmem_default = 33554432
net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 87380 33554432
net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 65536 33554432
net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1
net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout = 15
```
Apply immediately via:
```bash
sysctl -p
```

### 5.2 Storage Partitioning & Mount Options (`/etc/fstab`)
To maximize I/O performance on NVMe/SSD storage partitions (e.g. `/srv/bot-storage` on `/dev/vda4`):

```fstab
UUID=90980c8c-2bdf-47f0-a634-8f110bc20fb8 /srv/bot-storage ext4 defaults,noatime,nodiratime,commit=60,barrier=0,nofail 0 2
```
- `noatime,nodiratime`: Eliminates metadata write overhead when reading virtual extents via FUSE.
- `commit=60`: Flushes ext4 journal transactions every 60 seconds rather than default 5 seconds.

### 5.3 Docker Compose Production Specification
Running Linux FUSE inside Docker requires specific capability grants:

```yaml
services:
  mirror-leech-fuse:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: mirror-leech-fuse-app-1
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/fuse:/dev/fuse:rwm
    security_opt:
      - apparmor:unconfined
    volumes:
      - /srv/bot-storage/fuse_bot/app:/app
      - /srv/bot-storage/fuse_bot/downloads:/app/downloads
      - /srv/bot-storage/fuse_bot/accounts:/app/accounts
      - /srv/bot-storage/fuse_bot/tokens:/app/tokens
      - /srv/bot-storage/fuse_bot/rclone:/app/rclone
    environment:
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
      - TZ=UTC
    ulimits:
      nofile:
        soft: 65535
        hard: 65535
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "5"
```

### 5.4 Stale FUSE Mount Recovery Protocol
If a container or task crashes abnormally, stale mount endpoints in `/app/downloads/` can be unmounted using:

```bash
# Inside container:
cat /proc/mounts | grep archivemount | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r -n 1 fusermount -uz

# Or from host:
find /srv/bot-storage/fuse_bot/app/downloads/ -name ".mnt_*" -exec fusermount -uz {} + 2>/dev/null || true
```
